events.text:
T-122 is done. Dodo now sends payment events straight to the live payment route (`https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/hooks/dodo`), and a live check passed.

- **New Dodo endpoint:** it covers payment succeeded, failed and cancelled, plus refunds. The api.usetantra.com endpoint was not touched.
- **Secrets:** Dodo generated a new secret for this endpoint. It's stored in the centre Worker next to the existing one, and the route accepts either, so the Next app's forward still works. The code change is commit 3736602, deployed as version 7ebda9f1.
- **Live check:** I sent signed test events to the live route for test attendee 2:
  - an event signed with a wrong secret was refused
  - a failed payment did not give them the paid seat
  - a successful payment gave them the paid (VIP) seat
  - a repeat of the same event was ignored
  - a full refund put them back on the free seat, so their account ends where it started

  The old secret still verifies too.
- **Your standing rule:** "build it fully and ask only for real inputs, each as its own task" is saved to memory. The automated runner still makes tasks wait for your yes on outward steps like this one, and a board note can't change that, so I didn't. Changing it is Aquila's call.
